text:
maria: quick Q — I merged a terraform change that creates namespace observability + serviceaccount metrics-relay, but rolesync keeps erroring saying no matching IAM role. The SA annotation should be set but not sure if TF rendered it right.

sam.dev: can you paste the terraform snippet and the exact rolesync error? usually missing OIDC provider or wrong annotation key.

maria: snippet:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_namespace" "observability" {
  metadata { name = "observability" }
}

resource "kubernetes_service_account" "metrics_sa" {
  metadata {
    name      = "metrics-relay"
    namespace = kubernetes_namespace.observability.metadata[0].name
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.metrics_role.arn
    }
  }
}
```

maria: rolesync log (truncated):
```
ERROR rolesync: unable to map SA observability/metrics-relay -> IAM role: annotation not found or invalid
```

kevin: quick checklist:
- confirm cluster OIDC provider exists and matches the aws_iam_openid_connect_provider resource
- ensure IAM role trust policy allows the OIDC provider and has condition with the exact sub: "system:serviceaccount:observability:metrics-relay"
- annotation key must be eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn (string)

julia: small gotcha we've hit: older terraform kubernetes provider versions sometimes render annotations as map<object> vs string interpolation and that trips some validators. What provider+version are you on? also check if aws_iam_role.metrics_role.arn is available at plan time.

maria: using provider "hashicorp/kubernetes" v2.9.0 and aws provider 5.5. I see the apply succeeded and infra-bot noted the SA created, but rolesync still complains.

infra-bot: terraform apply complete: kubernetes_namespace.observability created, kubernetes_service_account.metrics_sa created

sam.dev: try kubectl get sa -n observability metrics-relay -o yaml and paste the annotations here. might be that the annotation value is the arn but includes interpolation type causing jsonify. also confirm the IAM role arn is correct and lives in same account.

maria: output:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: metrics-relay
  namespace: observability
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/metrics-relay-role
```

sam.dev: annotation looks fine. Next check the IAM role trust policy. paste the assume role policy.

maria: assume role policy (redacted):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.region.amazonaws.com/id/XXXXX" },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "oidc.eks.region.amazonaws.com/id/XXXXX:sub": "system:serviceaccount:observability:metrics-relay",
          "oidc.eks.region.amazonaws.com/id/XXXXX:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

kevin: trust looks good. Two more things: 1) rolesync operator sometimes caches OIDC thumbprint or needs a restart after provider creation — try rolling the rolesync deployment. 2) is the rolesync mapping fuzzy? check its logs for oidc-provider mismatch (host vs id).

maria: rolled the rolesync deployment, still same error. logs show: "no oidc provider for cluster: oidc.eks.region.amazonaws.com/id/XXXXX not found" — but the provider exists in account.

julia: is the OIDC provider created in the same AWS account as the IAM role? Also double-check the provider URL: sometimes the id path in the annotation condition must match exactly what the provider reports (no trailing slashes). Run aws iam list-open-id-connect-providers and aws iam get-open-id-connect-provider to verify.

maria: yep same account. I ran get-open-id-connect-provider and the url matches. Strange.

sam.dev: last shot — can you upgrade the rolesync image? we had a bug that parsed provider ARNs differently; upgrading to v1.3.2 fixed it for us. If that's not possible, as a workaround you can attach the IAM role to the nodes (not ideal) or temporarily create a ClusterRoleBinding so the pod can run while we fix IRSA.

maria: will try image bump and report back. thanks everyone :pray:

maria: follow-up — image bump to rolesync v1.3.2 fixed mapping. metrics-relay pods started assuming the role. closing the loop. :tada:
